howto: Pick LEVELS or MARATHON and press Play. Steer your crowd left and right (A / D, arrow keys or drag on touch).
Run through the gates that grow you (x2, +7) and dodge the ones that shrink you (÷3, −12).
Avoid the bars and the maces: they knock people out. At the end, the boss gate needs enough of a crowd to burst.
Stars: burst the gate, then bigger crowds at the gate for two and three stars. Coins buy crowd looks.
tips: Steer early: gates and hazards come faster as the run goes on.
Every level is a longer track with a tougher boss gate; every five levels a new world (light and ground) begins.
A daily goal pays coins once a day; the week stamps light on consecutive days.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right or A / D to steer; Space or Enter starts; M mutes; P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Drag left and right to steer; tap to start; the pause button sits bottom right

difficulty: Level N has a 300+80(N-1) m track (up to the classic 920 m) and a boss gate of 22+3.3(N-1) people, rising to 45+ from level 8. Marathon is the original 920 m run to a 45-person boss gate.

cheats.effect: Your crowd jumps by 40 runners (and every run starts with 48)
Maces, bars and gate posts knock nobody out

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere on the title (or Space) to start
features.instant-restart: Run again on the results screen, Space, or Restart in the pause menu
features.best-score-badge: Best on the title card and a live Best cell in the HUD
features.tutorial-card: A skippable coach card before the first gate on the first run; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.results: Result card with stars, score, coins, peak crowd, distance and knocked out
features.levels: LEVELS mode with a level picker and stars per level; MARATHON keeps the original run
features.stars: Three stars per level from the size of the crowd at the boss gate
features.worlds: Five worlds that retint the sky, light and ground
features.unlocks: Nine crowd looks: free, stars, coins, level or day-streak unlocks
features.daily-goal: One seeded daily goal with a coin reward, week stamps and a day streak

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card. High: up to 2x pixel ratio, soft shadows from every runner; Low: 1x, no shadow pass and half the roadside scenery.
